capabilities: hide headings that have no content between them and the next heading in reading mode
re-check headings automatically when switching between notes
work out of the box with no settings
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese); the manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. The plugin only affects reading mode; nothing is said about Live Preview.
problem: Obsidian's reading mode shows headings even when nothing is written under them, so empty heading levels clutter the rendered note.
summary: Reading-mode tweak that automatically hides headings that have no content beneath them in a note, with no configuration required.
